offers_products.reason: Makes specialty materials: advanced interlayers, Tritan copolyesters, cellulose acetate fibers, additives, chemical intermediates, and plastics.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured chemicals and materials; no main service offering beyond incidental technical support.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells materials to manufacturers and converters; consumers only buy finished goods made by others.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells chemicals and materials to automotive, building, packaging, personal care and tire manufacturers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Customers repeatedly order chemicals, additives, fibers and plastics as production inputs, often under supply agreements.

cyclical_demand.reason: Demand tied to autos, construction, durable goods and industrial output; customers cut orders in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Bulk chemical and material orders are frequent repeat purchases, not large infrequent capital purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Manufacturer of chemicals and materials; value comes from products and plants, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large multinational manufacturers in automotive, packaging, consumer goods, tires and coatings.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates large chemical plants, such as Kingsport site and methanolysis recycling facilities, needing ongoing capital investment.
